name: Gold (fear gauge)
summary: Gold near $3,591 on 20 Nov, down 6.8% on the week, inside the 7% Alert line; down 23.5% over three months
state: Gold futures were near $3,591 at 11:30 UTC on 20 Nov, 6.8% lower on the week and 23.5% lower over three months, and about a third below the 52-week high of $5,318 (Yahoo Finance). The weekly fall has eased back inside the 7% single-week Alert line after reaching 8.7% early on 20 Nov, so the level returns to Watch on the three-month fall of more than 8%. Rate-rise expectations and a firm dollar have weighed on the price through November.
for_you: Gold is in a sharp downswing as rate-rise expectations build. Savers and funds with precious-metals exposure have seen large swings in value over November.
rubric_hit: 3m fall 23.5% > 8% Watch line; 1w -6.8% inside the 7% Alert line
why: Gold is the oldest crisis hedge; disorderly surges signal fear about currencies, inflation or geopolitics.
drivers: Real interest rates, central-bank buying, geopolitical fear, dollar moves.

rubric.alert: 3-month gain > 20%, or a single-week move > 7% either way.
